fields.description: Initial value of 'Auto Submit Work Orders' on new PPC Production Plans.
fields.label: Auto-submit Work Orders by Default

fields.description: Same default as the standard Work Order form.
fields.label: Use Multi-Level BOM on Work Orders

fields.description: When Job Cards are synchronised and have no scheduled time (capacity planning disabled), write an estimated schedule from the Work Order start date and operation times.
fields.label: Auto-schedule Job Cards Without Dates

fields.description: Records processed per server call by the bulk submit dialogs.
fields.label: Bulk Action Batch Size

fields.description: Upper limit of Job Cards loaded into the Gantt chart per request.
fields.label: Max Gantt Bars

fields.description: Used only to estimate a duration when ERPNext holds no operation time.
fields.label: Default Operation Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: By default only roles holding the 'Override Conflicts' capability may save a reschedule that violates dependencies or workstation capacity.
fields.label: Production Planners May Override Conflicts
Machine Recommendation (Sales Order)
fields.description: How 'Find Best Machine' ranks the Workstations that are compatible with an operation. Weights never override compatibility: an incompatible machine is never offered.

fields.label: Weight: Earliest Completion
fields.description: Machines that finish the operation sooner rank higher.

fields.label: Weight: Lower Workload
fields.description: Machines that are less booked in the coming days rank higher.

fields.label: Weight: Meets Delivery Date
fields.description: Used only when the Sales Order has a delivery date.

fields.label: Weight: Lower Cost
fields.description: Used only when every candidate has an hourly rate.

fields.label: Weight: Efficiency
fields.description: Used only when every candidate has an efficiency set on the Operation.

fields.label: Look-ahead (Days)
fields.description: How far ahead a free slot is searched. A machine with no slot within this period is not recommended.

fields.label: Workload Window (Days)
fields.description: Booked share of capacity is measured over this many days from the earliest start.

fields.label: Unavailable After (Hours)
fields.description: When a Work Order is created, a chosen machine whose first free slot is this much later than the Work Order's planned start is treated as unavailable (the planner is notified).

fields.label: One Machine for All Operations
fields.description: Only machines compatible with every operation of the BOM are considered, and the same machine is recommended for all of them.

fields.label: Count Draft Work Orders as Bookings
fields.description: Draft Work Orders hold only placeholder times. Off (recommended): machines are judged on Job Cards, which hold the real schedule.

fields.label: Calculate MRP when a Sales Order is submitted
fields.description: Queues a background MRP run for the order. It only prepares recommendations for the MRP Review; nothing is created until a person confirms.

fields.label: Enable Automatic MRP
fields.description: Master switch for the automatic triggers below. Manual MRP runs are unaffected.

fields.label: Calculate MRP when a Production Plan is submitted
Automatic Draft Creation
fields.description: After an automatic calculation, create draft Material Requests / Work Orders without a review. Nothing is ever submitted.

fields.label: Review Mode for Manual Runs
fields.description: Review First: a person ticks lines and confirms. Automatic: Calculate also creates the drafts.

fields.label: Automation Policy Set By
fields.description: Who switched Automatic Draft Creation or the Automatic Review Mode on. Recorded with every document the policy creates.

fields.label: Warehouse Selection Policy
fields.description: Demand Warehouse: the line's own warehouse, else the default. Default Planning Warehouse: always the default.

fields.label: Include Safety Stock
fields.description: Item Safety Stock is held back from usable stock.

fields.label: Include Incoming Purchase Orders / Material Requests
Planning Horizon (days)
fields.description: Automatic runs plan demand due within this many days (1-1825).

fields.label: Default Procurement Lead Time (days)
fields.description: Used for items with no lead time of their own.

fields.label: Automatic Retries
fields.description: How many times a failed automatic run is retried by itself (0-5).

fields.label: Notify on MRP Failure
fields.description: Sends a notification to PPC Managers when an automatic run fails.

fields.label: Default Warehouse for Automatic MRP
fields.description: Used for demand and components that name no warehouse. Empty = the Sales Order's own warehouse, then Stock Settings.
Which roles may perform which PPC action. System Manager always can. Document-level ERPNext permissions (Work Order, Job Card ...) still apply on top.
